anim_format.format: KoeiAnim: header u8 n_rec, u8 n_img, u8 n_alpha, u8 has_pal, u32 delay_ms, u32 W, u32 H, u32 id; n_rec x 20-byte records; then the pictures: raw 8-bit (n_img then n_alpha WxH planes, exe palette), or one BMP24 / PNG of W x H*(n_img+n_alpha) (frames stacked)

record.p2: byte 2 (Mcall: p2 != 0 forces the blended path)
record.p3: byte 3: blend level L = p3*6+4 percent (0x4055fa / 0x402396 -> 0x40690c)
record.mode: u32 +4 (Mcall: mode != 0 forces the blended path)
record.dx: i32 +8: x offset added to the frame position
record.cue: byte +16: 1 = Meff hit frame (0x401e5d -> 0x421ab6 shows the targets hurt/defend pose + numbers); sound: plays on frame 0 unless cue == 2, and on every frame with cue == 3 (0x41c4ef / 0x403206)
record.opacity: precomputed: what the 6.6 player draws: bg*(1-o) + img*o for every non-key pixel

anim_format.playback: one record per tick; delay_ms is rounded down to the 50 ms timer tick (0x40273f/0x40bd5d divide by 50, 0x42c632 waits ticks of timeGetTime()/50). Frame top-left = (x - W/2 + dx, y - H/2 + dy) where (x, y) = target cell centre (cell pos + 24) (Meff 0x40196f/0x401a7c + 0x40208b, Mcall 0x421496 + 0x402b83)
anim_format.blend: 24-bit: key pixels (|c-(247,0,255)| < 12 per channel, alpha 0 in img_KK.png) are skipped; others: out = (bg*(100-L) + img*L) / 100 per channel, L = p3*6+4 (0x40690c, 0x415a64). Mcall records with mode == 0 and p2 == 0 are plain keyed copies (0x402b83). alpha_source "png": per-pixel alpha from the PNG instead of L (header byte 18 == 1 and a 32-bit PNG: Mcall 0x4055fa, Meff 0x40e905). The 8-bit alpha maps (alpha_KK.png) are decoded but not used by the 6.6 player.
anim_format.sound: sound = low byte of the header id; the player calls 0x46d0b7(sound + 100)

strategy_effect_table.source: Ekd5.exe MgMeff (VA 0x4d1960, file 0xA3160) and MgMcall (VA 0x4d19f0, file 0xA31F0), 144 strategies (System.ini MgMeff/MgMcall); category = MgID (VA 0x4d1570)
strategy_effect_table.rule: 0x421496: c = mcall[s]; if c == 255: nothing. If 100 <= c < 255: play Mcall(c % 100) (0x40eb54 -> 0x4060a9 -> 0x40eae0 "E5\MCALL%02u.E5") centred on the target cell centre (on the map view centre for categories 0x1c/0x1d), then (category 12 only) 0x4216c0 plays category12_multi. Then (any c != 255) e = meff[s]; if e != 255: play Meff[e] on every target cell (0x40bcd2 + 0x40196f + 0x401e5d)

category12_multi.rule: for each pair: Meff[meff[i]] on the targets whose effect byte (+0x401) == unit_effect_codes[i]

xben.source: Meff.e5 (Ls12, 60 KoeiAnim; 57 identical to wg2025 Xben.wa, 31 changed, 58/59 new), loader 0x40bcd2 -> 0x4318e5
xben.notes: entries 52..56 = 216x50 weather banners (0x449f91 plays 0x34 + weather at (108,25)); entry 45 fixed use at 0x423b94/0x42b7e5

dt.source: DT.e5 (Ls12, 60 KoeiAnim): loaded through the Meff loader with the file name patched to DT.E5 (0x40da9a writes 0xfa/0xb7 into 0x40bd21/0x40bd34: name 0x48bbfa, 16-bit index) for the 40 animated object slots of script handler 0x4295fb (slot = arg 0, object word +0x12 = DT entry + 1; 0 removes it)
dt.notes: entries 7..59 are byte-identical to Meff.e5; 0..6 are new single pictures with an embedded BMP24

mcall.source: E5/Mcall00..22.e5 (raw KoeiAnim files), opened by 0x40eae0 (sprintf "E5\MCALL%02u.E5", v % 100) -> 0x402a24 (player object 0x492788, stream thread 0x41295c: header 0x40273f, pictures 0x4027c9/0x4025a7); play 0x403035, frame draw 0x402b83
mcall.notes: referenced by the shipped MgMcall table: 00-08 and 11. Mcall12 has a PNG but header byte 18 == 0, so the engine ignores its alpha (keyed RGB at level L, as converted). 0x40eab4 can also open "E5\MCALL%03u.E5" (3 digits, number = the unit's person word); no such files ship.

ranges_attack.role: reach diagrams (which cells can be targeted), loader 0x46fc61 (mode 0, no key). Unit info 0x477b7f: index = class record byte +1 (attack range type), window slot 5. Strategy info 0x46fa82: index = strategy record byte +0x0c (0xff -> 16; an index >= the entry count reads entry 0, 0x41fc89), or 11 when record byte +0x0f == 0x28

ranges_strategy.source: Effarea.e5 (10 x 64x64 PNG; alpha 225..255 ignored by the engine -> saved opaque)
ranges_strategy.role: effect-area diagrams (cells hit around the target), loader 0x46fc61. Unit info: index = 0x407835(person) (attack area type), slot 6. Strategy info: index = strategy byte +0x0d & 0x0f (0xff -> 16 -> entry 0); 0 when record byte +0x0f == 0x28, or when the dialog flag (+0x50 -> +0x74) is 0 and MgID[s] == 0x1a

tr.source: Tr.e5 (11 x 64x64 PNG; 0..9 identical to Effarea.e5)
tr.role: RPG-scene picture objects: script handler 0x425bf2 puts Tr entry (actor word +0x3a) into actor slot 0x6a + arg0 (arg0 < 8); 0x42789d loads it (mode 10 = keyed, one frame of W x H). Slots >= 0x72 load U_SELECT.E5 the same way with 10 frames of H/10 (0x42a049)

weather.source: Weather.e5 (5 x 216x200 raw 8-bit, exe palette; = rea Xthree.wa), loader 0x449ef0 (mode 10)
weather.rule: entry = weather = table VA 0x48e100[climate*6 + level] (0x41553b); on a change 0x449f91 plays Meff[0x34 + weather] at (108, 25) then reloads the panel
weather.role: battle weather panel: 0 clear, 1 cloudy, 2 rain, 3 heavy rain, 4 snow

map_patches.source: Gate.e5: 192 JPEG 144x144 (3x3 cells), copied byte for byte
map_patches.role: battle-map terrain-change patches. 0x4376ea loads the entry (mode 10) and cuts it into 48x48 cells (0x473d4a); 0x437779 copies each cell into the map picture centred on the target cell, skipping cells outside the map (and darkens it for night/fog via 0x42a8ed). No palette any more.
map_patches.rule: patch code v (4..200, stored in the change record +4, table VA 0x4b3d21, 250 x 5 bytes): apply = entry 2*v - 8 (0x4563ff, reload 0x456e7c), restore = entry 2*v - 7 (0x4567dd). v < 4 or v > 200 are small marks, not Gate pictures
map_patches.key_cells: entries listing key_cells contain colour-key (247,0,255) cells (1 = keyed 48x48 cell); the engine copies them unkeyed, so they must lie outside the map when used
